podcast.body: A deep cut from The Weeknd's 2016 album "Starboy," this track reached number 43 on the Hot 100, part of the phenomenon where all 18 album tracks simultaneously charted, burnishing his imperiality despite its lower individual position. "Two such deep cuts as Die for you, which only reached number 43."

podcast.body: Originally released in 2016 as an unpromoted album cut from the "Starboy" LP, "Die for you" briefly charted at number 43. Five years later, it saw a surge in consumption after going viral on TikTok through "glow-up videos," leading to radio airplay in 2022 and a return to the Hot 100. By early 2023, it reached the Top 10, prompting The Weeknd to release a duet remix with Ariana Grande in March 2023, which lifted the song to number one. "A duet remix of Die for you arrived in March of this year and lifted the song all the way to number one."
